# VK

> VK (ВКонтакте) is a Russian social network and digital platform offering event ticketing, account management, and entertainment services across web and mobile applications.

VK provides integrated services including account registration with SMS verification, a ticketing platform (VK Билеты) for concerts, theater, and comedy shows across Russian cities, and support resources for users. The platform operates across iOS, Android, and desktop environments.

## Key Topics

- VK Билеты (VK Tickets)
- Account Registration
- SMS Verification
- Event Tickets
- Concert & Theater
- Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)
- Phone Verification
- Desktop Platform
- Comedy Shows
- Theater Performances
- Ticket Purchase
- Getting Started
- Account Setup
- Russian Cities
- Entertainment Events

## Event Ticketing

- [VK Билеты | Гурам Амарян — Рязань](https://tickets.vk.com/riazan/event/guram-amarian-1155375): Buy tickets for Guram Amarian comedy show in Ryazan, Dec 2026
- [VK Билеты | Мой цветок — Саратов](https://tickets.vk.com/saratov/event/moi-tsvetok-1155537): Theater tickets for drama performance in Saratov, May 2026
- [VK Билеты | Султан Лагучев — Тюмень](https://tickets.vk.com/tiumen/event/sultan-laguchev-tiumen-873914): Concert tickets for Sultan Laguchev live music in Tyumen, Apr 2026
- [VK Билеты | С любовью, Эрнест — Нижний Новгород](https://tickets.vk.com/nizhnii-novgorod/event/s-liuboviu-ernest-1115527): Audio spectacle tickets for romantic Hemingway experience, Mar 2026

- [Как зарегистрировать аккаунт? | VK](https://vk.com/faq18549?lang=en): Account registration guide with SMS verification and setup instructions
